dct_description_sm: This dataset contains neighborhoods of several towns in Libya Contains name of neighborhood (name_neigh), admin level (1 and 2), mantika, baladiya (when available), muhalla (Ubari only), data of data collection and data collection method. Data collection was done by participatory mapping, with 2 different methods, depending on cities. Thus, data must not be considered as official boundaries: In Azzawya, Derna, Ejdabia, Tawergha, Sebha, Sultan, Ubari and Zouitina areas, the neighborhood boundaries have been identified and drawn in consultation with local governance stakeholders through a participatory mapping focus group discussion (FGD in the source field of the dataset). In Albayda, Benghazi, Ghat, Misrata, Zliten, Tripoli, Zoltan and Zwara areas, the neighborhood boundaries have been identified and drawn by the REACH Senior Field Officers and ACTED Area Coordinators, based on their knowledge of the area.
